people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
translations.bsb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
translations.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for ➔ the elect's sakes, that they may ➔ also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
translations.asv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
